title: kithd: discovery round aborts on store-lock poison instead of continuing
description: In discovery.rs run_discovery_round, when the store Mutex is poisoned the code uses return inside the join_set drain loop, which exits the entire function. Remaining JoinSet tasks continue running but their results are permanently dropped. Discovery is permanently degraded if the store stays poisoned. Fix: use continue instead of return inside the per-result processing loop so a poisoned store skips only that one upsert, allows the loop to drain completely, and logs errors without killing the whole round.
